title: Strong convergence is not norm convergence
promptMarkdown: Let $P_N$ be projection onto the first N coordinates of $\ell^2$. Show $P_Nx\to x$ for every x but $\|P_N-I\|=1$. Prove the identity is not compact. Explain why finite-rank approximation in operator norm, not merely pointwise convergence, is the correct compactness criterion.
hintLadder: Compare the order of the quantifiers in the two convergence statements.
Test a basis vector just beyond the projected coordinates.

criteria.criterion: Proves pointwise norm convergence and exact operator-norm error.
